item.title: Pistol Shooters Take Aim As India Hope For A Strong Start In Asian Championship
item.description: World Cup Final Champion Suruchi: Pistol shooters will take aim at the Dr. Karni Singh Shooting Ranges here in Delhi, as medals in 10m Air pistol events will be decided as competition day one will be underway tomorrow in the Asian Championship Rifle/Pistol.

item.title: Politics Hurting World Cricket, IPL The Only Winner If Boycotts Continue: Lalit Modi On India–Pak T20 World Cup Row
item.description: Pak T20 World Cup: Former Indian Premier League (IPL) chairman Lalit Modi has criticised Pakistan’s decision to boycott its group-stage fixture against India in the ICC Men’s T20 World Cup, saying the spirit of cricket is diminished when politics influences sporting participation.

item.title: Chattisgarh Open: Akshay Sharma Takes First-round Lead With A Phenomenal Nine-under 60
item.description: Nava Raipur Greenfield Capital City: Akshay Sharma shot a phenomenal nine-under 60 to take the first-round lead at the INR 1.5 crore Chhattisgarh Open 2026, the PGTI’s season-opener.

item.title: Jacob Bethell Spins England to 3-0 T20I Clean Sweep Over Sri Lanka
item.description: Jacob Bethell claimed career-best figures of 4/11 as England defended 128 to beat Sri Lanka by 12 runs at Pallekele, completing a 3-0 T20I series clean sweep ahead of the T20 World Cup.

item.title: Leverkusen Beat St. Pauli In German Cup Quarterfinal
item.description: Joel Chima Fujita: Bayer Leverkusen booked a place in the German Cup semifinals with a 3-0 home win over St. Pauli on Tuesday.

item.title: England Seek Fresh Start at T20 World Cup as Harry Brook Faces Early Test as Captain
item.description: England begin their T20 World Cup campaign aiming to move on from Ashes disappointment and recent white-ball failures, with new captain Harry Brook under scrutiny both on and off the field.

item.title: Arsenal Reach Carabao Cup Final After Last-gasp Havertz Goal
item.description: Carabao Cup Final: Kai Havertz netted a dramatic late winner as Arsenal reached the Carabao Cup final with a 4-2 aggregate victory over Chelsea.

item.title: WPL: We've Plenty Of Time To Tinker A Little Bit and Come Back Stronger Next Year, Says GG Head Coach Klinger
item.description: Royal Challengers Bengaluru: Head coach Michael Klinger felt the Gujarat Giants' WPL 2026 season demonstrated noticeable progress, despite an overall sense of unfinished goals, as the side concluded their campaign with a loss to Delhi Capitals in the Eliminator on Tuesday.

item.title: FC Barcelona Ease Past Albacete To Reach Copa Del Rey SF
item.description: FC Barcelona: Reigning Copa del Rey holder FC Barcelona became the first team to reach the semifinals with a 2-1 win away to second division side Albacete.

item.title: 'One Of The Most Dangerous Teams': Dhoni On India’s T20 WC Squad
item.description: Mahendra Singh Dhoni: Former India captain Mahendra Singh Dhoni expressed confidence in the Indian team's prospects for the Men’s T20 World Cup 2026, highlighting that they possess the right combination of experience, skill, and balance to perform well in a high-pressure tournament.
